source: Read Table167 physical486–487 and ADR1179. Export-as-screen is explicit product policy, not a third ISO device requirement.
existing_tests: Read actual print_intent matrix/no-AP test, annotation ToggleNoView test and public printing test. Distinguish marks counts from pixels.

Public transform API writes PNG for NoView+Print, Print-only and absent annotation; independent red/white pixels prevent equal-wrong-output success.
corrections: Draft title mentioned Hidden without testing it; renamed. Strengthened alpha-only/equality-only observations with literal pixels. Added support module and fixed import placement. No new failure.
limits: No native dialog or printer driven. Export has no pointer state. Widget/form/selection and archive rewrites remain outside these new assertions.
